column1: # What a hoisted-sail heading key and the synthesized repeats print.
# `commands.md §5.2`: "Outdoor movement prints its compass word followed by a
# newline." `weather.md §5`: under hoisted sail the first heading key only
# sets the cached direction, and "the input helper can synthesize repeated
# movement commands from the cached direction". `text-output.md §10.2`: any
# shipboard direction suppresses exactly one following prompt pair.
# `sail-calm` (2026-10-16) caught the stock game, wind drifted to South,
# printing `>BREAKING UP!` straight under `>Yell HOIST!` - no `East` for the
# heading key or for the released step into the shoal - where this engine
# printed `>East` first. This scenario sails away from the coast instead, so
# the released steps are ordinary moves, and samples the window as they go.
# requires-seed: profile `seed-drowning-collision` (frigate west of a coast)

column4: Furled frigate west of the coast
